docs.title: Pack the order (scan and pack)
docs.text: Do this at least two hours before the customer arrives. 8 steps.

steps.text: Select the customer's name under Ready to pack, review the order, then select Pack. Where: Pickups → Ready to pack → customer's name. You'll see: Order details: when it was placed, any pickup appointment, their services, bags to pack, items ordered, and the core and Xfinity Mobile equipment on the order. Tip: If they ordered core and Xfinity Mobile, you'll see two line items. Pack two separate bags and run scan and pack once for each.

Select Open scanner and scan the SKU on each device or piece of equipment. You'll see: Scan items: a list of everything on the order marked Not scanned. Retrieve the items and scan them in the order they appear.
Point the camera at the barcode and scan. You'll see: The scanner opens on Barcode for scan and pack. It opens on QR Code for pickups and unpacks. You can also switch to Manual.

Read the confirmation after each scan. You'll see: Success: a green check and “Scanned”. It closes by itself after five seconds, or select Close. Heads up: Error: a red ! that stays on screen. Select Retry when you're ready to scan a different device.

Review the scanned items, then select Add items. You'll see: Add to account: each item with its MAC address, IMEI or SIM. Add items adds the equipment to the customer's account. Tip: If an item gets dropped or damaged after you scanned it, select Replace on that line and scan the new one.

Select Open scanner and scan your printer to print the packing slip. You'll see: “Items were added to the customer's order.” On orders with several devices, each one is listed with its own Replace button and a Print slip button. Tip: Scan the printer you want to print to.

Select Done, attach the slip, and store the order securely. Where: Core orders: attach the slip to the bag and put it in the staging cart at the front of the house. Mobile orders: attach the slip to the bag, or wrap it around the device with a rubber band, and store it where your store keeps devices (safe room, old-style safe, or the set-aside back-of-house area). You'll see: Finish path — “That's a wrap!” Select Finish.

Check that the customer moved to the Packed queue. You'll see: The order is ready for pickup. Heads up: Look at Ready to pack one more time. If the customer has a second order (core or mobile), pack that one too.

docs.title: Complete the pickup
docs.text: When the customer arrives, check them in. The order should be in Packed. Find out whether it's a quick pickup or a consultative appointment. If the order isn't packed yet, pack it first, then come back here. 12 steps.

steps.text: Select the customer's name in the Packed queue. Where: Pickups → Packed → customer's name. Tip: Look for more than one line item. That means more than one order.
Select Check-in.

Go through the check-in form. It's filled in for you. You'll see: Guest details has the account's primary user already selected. In Visit details, the reason for visit is already Online Order Pick Up, with a BAPIS order packed banner.

Find the customer in the Waiting queue and select Start. You'll see: The session begins. A quick pickup goes to the top of the queue. An appointment is placed by appointment time. The customer's page shows a BAPIS order packed banner with how long the order stays active and that the primary account holder must pick it up. Tip: If someone else on the account checked in (not the primary account holder), the banner says the order is waiting for the primary account holder.

Select who is there for the pickup and ask for their photo ID. Heads up: Mobile orders: primary account holder only. Core orders: primary, manager or authorized user. Anyone else gets an error here (see Account owner required below). Tip: This should be the primary account holder.
Select the type of ID the customer gave you, then Next. You'll see: Customer Authentication: Photo ID or Non-photo ID.

Enter the customer's six-digit pickup code and select Verify. Heads up: Three wrong codes cancel the order. An Xfinity-provided email address can't receive the code. There is no workaround for the pickup code. Tip: The code was sent when they ordered, to the verified email on the primary account holder's profile. Need it again? Select Resend code.

After Pickup code accepted, go over the equipment with the customer. You'll see: Review order: order summary, bags to pick up, items ordered and the device details. Tip: Make sure they know what they're getting.
Select Process payment to take the customer's payment. You'll see: “Processing payment.” It can take up to four and a half minutes. When it says the process is complete, select Next.
Select Open scanner and scan the order's packing slip. You'll see: The order's bag flips from Not scanned to Scanned. Select Next.

Get the customer's signature, then select Done. You'll see: Collect signature: they can Draw it on the touchscreen or Type their name. Tip: The signature confirms they received everything and the order is correct.
Select Finish. The pickup is done. Tip: If they have a core order and a mobile order, run the pickup twice, once for each order.

docs.title: BAPIS — Scan, Pack & Pick Up: before you start
docs.text: Every BAPIS order lives in Celestial → Store Space → Pickups, sorted into three queues: Ready to pack, Packed and Unpack. Pack the order at least two hours before the customer is due in the store. Core and Xfinity Mobile bought together show up as two line items. That means two bags, and you pack and hand over each one separately. Mobile orders can only be picked up by the primary account holder. Core orders can be picked up by the primary, a manager, or an authorized user. Orders not picked up within four days move to the Unpack queue by themselves.

docs.title: BAPIS — Scan, Pack & Pick Up: good to know
docs.text: Pack early. Two hours before arrival is the rule, so a customer who walks in early isn't left waiting while you scan. Core and Mobile = two bags, two scan-and-packs, two pickups. The pickup code only goes to a verified, non-Xfinity email on the primary account holder's profile. There's no way around it. Three wrong pickup codes cancel the order. Unclaimed orders go to Unpack after four days. Unpack them so the stock goes back on the shelf. For the full Celestial packing course, see the BAPIS training in Ulearn.

docs.title: Address & identity
docs.text: Every Xfinity customer has to verify their identity before services can be ordered. 4 steps.

steps.text: Type the service address, pick it from the list, and click Continue. Where: The Let's get started screen.

Enter name, phone and email, check SMS consent, pick a language, click Next. Where: The Let's get you signed up screen. Tip: Enter the customer's first name, last name, phone number and email. Check the SMS consent box and choose English or Spanish.,If the customer gives a mobile number and opts in to texts, they get a one-time passcode to verify. That's the fastest way through.

Enter the one-time passcode from the customer's text, then click Next. You'll see: The code expires in 5 minutes. Use Resend if it didn't arrive, or I would like to verify my identity another way. Tip: Have the customer read you the code from their text.

If asked, enter Date of Birth and Social Security number, then click Next. Heads up: No SSN, or the customer doesn't want to share it? Check Alternate ID Verification. They'll have to upload a selfie holding their ID later. Tip: This is not a credit check. Say so up front, because customers worry about it.,More than 30 alternate IDs are accepted, including international documents. See *Upload documents & selfie* below.

docs.title: Internet Essentials — Agent Portal: before you start
docs.text: Be on the store's Retail WiFi. The agent portal only opens on the Comcast network. Celestial lists it as "must be on VPN", and in the store the Retail WiFi covers that. No Sales ID, no pay. Before every application, check that your Sales ID is saved in the portal. It's the same 5-digit code you use to enter sales in CSG. Have the customer there with their phone. They'll get a one-time passcode by text, and they may need to photograph a document or their ID. Don't refresh the page in the middle of an application. The applicant's data won't be saved. Quick eligibility check: Xfinity Internet is available at the address · no Xfinity Internet in the last 90 days · no Comcast debt less than a year old · on an assistance program (NSLP, housing assistance, Medicaid, SNAP, SSI and others) or household income at or below 200% of the Federal Poverty Level.

docs.title: Internet Essentials — Agent Portal: good to know
docs.text: Approvals are valid for 12 months. An existing IE customer who's moving doesn't fill out a new application. Do the transfer in CSG. IE can't be bundled. Customers can still add Xfinity TV, Xfinity Home, NOW TV, NOW TV Latino, NOW StreamSaver and Xumo Stream Box. They can't get Xfinity Flex or the Seasonal Convenience Plan. Existing TV, Mobile or Voice customers who don't have Xfinity Internet can sign up for IE. New customers get an XB6 gateway. Existing IE customers keep their XB3 unless they move tiers, and then CSG pops up an XB6 swap offer. Customers can use their own modem, but remind them the gateway is included at no cost. Application status: at internetessentials.com, customers click Application Status and enter their phone number and last name. They can also call 1-855-8-INTERNET (1-855-846-8376). If ID was verified in the store, approval can take three to five business days. If the customer still hasn't heard back after that, chat the IE team in ECM. Amnesty: a household whose only Xfinity debt is more than a year old (from the final disconnect date) can still qualify, and that old debt is forgiven. It doesn't cover Xfinity Mobile debt, and they can't upgrade or add services for a year. CSG shows a CRE pop-up with the amnesty expiration date. New York residents have additional ways to qualify (senior citizen or disability rent increase exemptions, or a utility affordability benefit). Approved customers can buy a Dell laptop for $149.99 plus tax, one per household. The Welcome Kit explains how. Dell support: 1-800-624-9896.

docs.text: Encourage the app first. Use XM360 when the customer needs you. Not for smartwatches (see section 14). For new devices, BYOD, and replacements from XMC, Apple or other makers. 9 steps. docs.text: Not CN – Connected or CN – Installed Enabled in green? Use Manage SIM Troubleshooting. XM360 shows each device's Network Status. Green is good (RS, or connected and working). The eSIM was downloaded.; iPhone toggle — Settings › Cellular › SIM Manager › Xfinity Mobile › Turn On This Line off, then on.; Pixel toggle — Settings › Network & Internet › SIMs › Xfinity Mobile eSIM off, then on.; Motorola toggle — Settings › Network & Internet › SIMs & Mobile Network › Xfinity Mobile eSIM off, then on.; Samsung toggle — Settings › Connections › SIM Manager › Xfinity Mobile eSIM off, then on.

docs.title: eSIM Xfinity Mobile Activation Guide: before you start
docs.text: Put the device on WiFi first (the store WiFi in store, home WiFi at home). Every eSIM step needs internet. Device charged or plugged in, and updated to the latest software. Customer has saved anything that won't move over on its own, like voicemails, photos and files. Porting a number? Have the previous carrier's account number and transfer PIN ready. docs.title: eSIM Xfinity Mobile Activation Guide: good to know
docs.text: Most activations finish in under 10 minutes. A smartwatch can take up to 30 minutes. The eSIM QR code only works once the device is in RS (Ready State). If XM360 doesn't show RS, the QR code and the push notification won't work yet. A phone can't scan a QR code on its own screen. Show the QR on the store iPad or a computer. If the customer only has the one phone, use the manual code in section 07. eSIM to pSIM is not available. When the buy flow decides a device should use eSIM, the pSIM option is greyed out on purpose. Don't escalate eSIM→pSIM requests to ECM > XM Support. Xfinity Mobile supports one mobile service per device (Xfinity Mobile, Comcast Business Mobile or NOW Mobile), even on a dual-SIM phone. The second slot can be another carrier or a travel data plan. Billing start: BYOD eSIM and in-stock purchases bill when the order completes. Shipped devices and pSIM cards bill on delivery. Smartwatches bill at setup or 7 days after purchase, whichever is first. A one-time $25 line activation fee applies to every new phone or tablet line. Deleting an eSIM doesn't cancel the plan. Erasing the phone lets the customer choose to keep the eSIM. Never try a SIM swap or a line deactivation on a device that isn't working or doesn't seem to have an eSIM. Troubleshoot first, then escalate through standard procedures. Everything here applies to NOW Mobile customers too.

steps.text: Open the account in Customer Space and launch XM360. See Launch XM360.

docs.text: XM360 locks after three failed SSN tries. New customer: treat it as a fraud check; they can try online after two hours (no greenlight). Existing customer: open an XM Support ECM case, XM360 Issues. 4 steps.

Change blocked email domains: @usa.com, @gmx.com, @mail.com. Existing customers also need a valid phone number and email on the XM360 overview. Changes take up to 15 minutes.

docs.title: Add the line
docs.text: 9 steps.

steps.text: Open the account in Customer Space and launch XM360. See Launch XM360.
On the Devices page, click Add another line.
Click Start customer entry, then Submit when the customer finishes. This sends an iGuard request. The customer enters their date of birth and SSN on their phone's keypad.
Check how many lines they can add, if needed. Where: Device icon (top right) > Eligibility. Shows phone, tablet/watch and total lines allowed, plus how much of the device payment plan limit is used.
Pick a device, or choose bring your own device (BYOD). Tip: BYOD steps: Add a line with the customer's own phone.

Set trade-in, payment, protection, plan and number; click Add to Cart. Payment is Pay in Full or Monthly (Device Payment Plan). To keep their number, choose Keep current number — see Enter porting info.
Click Continue to Order Review, go over amounts, click Continue. Cover Due today, Estimated bill difference, Due on the next bill and Estimated monthly bill.
Confirm shipping, payment and contact info, then get approval. On Customer Agreement, choose Text message, Email or Verbal consent only.
Click Place order, then activate the device. Tip: Next: Activate a device on a new line.

Pick Phones or Tablets, then Check IMEI for BYOD. Tip: Bringing a smartwatch? That uses separate watch steps.

Click Continue to Order Review, go over amounts, then Continue to Checkout.
Get the customer's approval, select Continue, then Place order. Tip: Next: Activate a device on a new line. Use Text message or Email for digital approval when you can.

docs.title: Common BYOD errors
crumbs: Add a line with the customer's own phone (BYOD)
docs.text: BYO200: Device locked by previous carrier — unlock it or pick a new device. BYO1900: Carrier lock cannot be confirmed — follow the on-screen instructions. BYO600 / BYO800: Device is tied to an active or suspended line — deactivate it first.

docs.title: Enter porting info to keep their number
crumbs: Enter porting info to keep their number
docs.text: Enter the old carrier's details so the customer's current number moves to their new line. Stay with the customer until the number works. Don't let them leave until the port is complete. Have the old carrier's account number and transfer PIN ready. Some PINs expire in 24 hours, others in seven days.

docs.title: Enter the port
crumbs: Enter porting info to keep their number
docs.text: Landline numbers usually take 48–72 hours, sometimes 7–10 days. Set expectations before the customer leaves. 9 steps.

steps.text: Choose Keep current number in the order, or Begin porting at activation. See Add a line or Activate a device on a new line.

Open Carrier Details and pick the customer's old carrier. Prepaid carrier and ZIP unknown? A pop-up reminds you to use alternate ZIP 33178 — only for TracFone, Consumer Cellular, T-Mobile Prepaid, Simple Mobile, Safe Link, TelCel, Total Wireless, Net 10, Straight Talk, Walmart Family Mobile and Walmart-SafeLink.
Enter the Account number and Account PIN/password. Letters in the account number must be capitalized. No PIN? Enter a space — leaving it blank auto-fills "PASSWORD".

Enter name, Last 4 SSN and address exactly as old carrier has. Use the address from when they first signed up. No commas in City; use the state abbreviation. Business: put the business name in First Name.
Check the MDN field shows the right number, then select Activate. Porting MDN: 10 digits only, no special characters. Status shows Activation Processing on Devices and in the Notification Center.

Wait three to five minutes, then refresh until Port successful. Port pending may need five to seven more minutes. Port confirmed... activation pending needs nothing else — it finishes by the due date shown, and the customer gets an email.
Yellow banner? Fix the fields it names and resubmit. Common codes: 6C info doesn't match, 8A account number, 8C PIN, 8D ZIP, 8E first name, 8F last name.
Red banner, or pending over 12 minutes? Open an XM Support case. In ECM, pick Activation/porting > Porting errors.
Porting more lines from that carrier? Click Use previous information. Fields fill from the first line; enter each line's Porting Phone Number (MDN).

crumbs: Move a number onto an active line (deferred port)
docs.text: Bring a customer's number from another carrier onto an Xfinity Mobile line that's already active. The number must be active at the old carrier, with number lock off. Tell the customer the line's voicemail won't carry over. Port within 30 days of activation to qualify for a promo.

docs.title: Submit the port
crumbs: Move a number onto an active line (deferred port)
docs.text: Don't cancel a submitted port unless the customer asks. Still stuck? Open an XM Support ECM case. 9 steps.

steps.text: Open the account in Customer Space and launch XM360. See Launch XM360.
Go to Devices and select the line getting the number.
Confirm the IMEI, and call the number to check it's active.
Select Change Number, then Port Existing.
Have the customer power off, then enter the old carrier's details. Account holder name, last four of SSN, account number, Number Transfer PIN and billing address. Field tips: Enter porting info.
Get a verbal yes that the line's current number goes away. The line is briefly deactivated, then reactivated with the ported number.
Select Submit port. Wireless numbers take 10 minutes to 72 hours; landlines 2 to 10 business days. Service stays on the current number meanwhile.
Check Activations; if Resolution Required, click See details and fix. Still processing shows "Port pending Awaiting response.".
When done, have the customer restart the phone. You'll see: The phone updates to the new number. Still not updated? They may need to reset network settings.

docs.text: Activate an eSIM or pSIM device on a new line, port the number if planned, and confirm it works. Didn't plan to port but now wants to? Use a deferred port. 8 steps.

steps.text: Open the account in Customer Space and launch XM360. See Launch XM360.
Select the Devices tab, then Activations. A red dot next to Activations means action is needed.
Select the device, then click Get Started.
Follow the activation checklist on screen. The steps depend on the device type, the porting choice and the device status.
Click refresh; open any step with a red exclamation mark. Updates can take up to three minutes. Green checkmarks are done.
Use the built-in troubleshooting; reissue the eSIM if offered. No reissue option means the issue isn't SIM-related — keep working the checklist.

Porting? Click Begin porting, enter the info, then Submit port. Only shows if they chose to port during the order. Get an alternate contact number first — the old carrier's service ends when the port finishes. Field help: Enter porting info.
When complete, click View checklist and make a test call. Confirm device setup, network connection, test call and number lock status.

docs.title: What each status means
docs.text: Delivered but not updated? Assurant can take up to 15 business days. Reps print the label only at the sale; customers reprint it later. They use the Assurant email or Devices in their online account. Order placed — Ship the old device with the label within 21 days.; Device is on its way — It's headed to Assurant. Track at xfinity.com/mobile.; Device is in review — Assurant is reviewing it. Turn off Find My by the date given.; Trade-in accepted — A trade-in credit will be applied to the monthly statement.; Trade-in not accepted — Share the reason. The device ships back.; Trade-in canceled — The device ships back. It may not qualify for another trade-in promo for 45 days.; Adjusted offer pending — Accept or decline by the date shown.; Adjusted offer accepted — Credit shows in one to two billing cycles.; Adjusted offer declined — Share the reason. The device ships back.

docs.title: Start the claim
crumbs: Start an Xfinity Mobile Care (XMC) claim
docs.text: 7 steps.

steps.text: Open the account in Customer Space and launch XM360. See Launch XM360.
On Devices, select the device the claim is for.
Expand Actions, select Device Protection, then Start claim.
Enter the customer's phone, email and the device's phone number (MDN).

Enter the claim date and answer the device condition questions. Do you still have possession of your device?; Did your device come in contact with liquid?; Has your device been dropped or damaged by accident?; Is your device lost, misplaced or is it unable to be recovered from its known location? Heads up: Check the device condition with the customer first. A wrong answer can get the claim denied, delayed or charged the wrong deductible.
Click Submit, then note the claim number.

Give the customer the claim number and explain next steps. Tip: No text or email? Confirm contact info in XM360 and have the customer contact Assurant. Status: Xfinity Mobile Care app, Assurant's claims website, or 1-855-884-9771. Assurant texts and/or emails a link. The customer must use it to complete and submit the claim within 30 days.

docs.title: AT&T porting: good to know
docs.text: Wireless Account Lock blocks the port, SIM swaps and line changes. Business accounts: only the primary user can request it, and not through *PORT or the app. FirstNet & Family accounts need a PIN; other FirstNet accounts don't. docs.title: C³ Arcade
docs.text: Every game on the site on one screen — pick a cabinet and it opens right here. 6 games: C³ FOX RUN, AFTER HOURS, DEEP SIX, BLUFOX OVERDRIVE, BLUFOX CASINO, WINDY CITY DERBY.
asks: im on break what can i play

docs.title: C³ FOX RUN
docs.text: The break-room arcade cabinet. Run the fox, dodge the obstacles, hold the high score. Run the fox down the line, clear what the floor throws at you, and hold the high score.

docs.title: AFTER HOURS
docs.text: The second cabinet in the C³ arcade. When the floor is quiet, the break room is not. The lights are off and the store is yours. When the floor is quiet, the break room is not.

docs.title: DEEP SIX
docs.text: The third cabinet in the C³ arcade. Read the sonar, call the shot, and put the other fleet on the bottom. Blufox Fleet Command. Read the sonar, call the shot, and put the other fleet on the bottom.

docs.title: BLUFOX OVERDRIVE
docs.text: The fourth cabinet in the C³ arcade. Eight karts, six circuits, and a Chicago night that does not slow down. Eight karts, six circuits, one Chicago night. Tilt the phone to steer and hold the racing line.

docs.title: BLUFOX CASINO
docs.text: The fifth cabinet in the C³ arcade. Seven 3D tables dealt by Ace: blackjack, hold'em, roulette, slots, baccarat, craps and video poker — play chips only, nothing to buy and nothing to win. Seven 3D tables, one fox in a tuxedo. Blackjack, hold'em, roulette, baccarat, craps, slots and video poker. Play chips only.

docs.title: WINDY CITY DERBY
docs.text: The sixth cabinet in the C³ arcade. Pick one of six foxes and swing for the seats at Wrigley or Rate Field — ten outs a round, a daily challenge, and a company-wide leaderboard. Pick your fox, step in at Wrigley or Rate Field and put one on the street. Ten outs a round, plus a daily challenge on the company board.

docs.title: Blackjack — Blufox Casino
docs.text: Blackjack (The Classic 21 · 3:2 PAYS) at the Blufox Casino, dealt by Ace. Play chips only — nothing to buy and nothing to win.

docs.title: Texas Hold’em — Blufox Casino
docs.text: Texas Hold’em (Six Seats · No Limit · 5 RIVALS) at the Blufox Casino, dealt by Ace. Play chips only — nothing to buy and nothing to win.

docs.title: Roulette — Blufox Casino
docs.text: Roulette (European · Single Zero · 35 TO 1) at the Blufox Casino, dealt by Ace. Play chips only — nothing to buy and nothing to win.

docs.title: Midnight Fox — Blufox Casino
docs.text: Midnight Fox (5 Reels · 20 Lines · FREE SPINS) at the Blufox Casino, dealt by Ace. Play chips only — nothing to buy and nothing to win.

docs.title: Baccarat — Blufox Casino

docs.title: Craps — Blufox Casino
